rules.title: Game Rules
rules.subtitle: Everything you need to know to become the Prediction King
rules.modes_intro: Depending on your admin's configuration, the prediction pool can be played in two ways:
rules.mode_a_desc: You must fill in the entire bracket (Groups + Full Bracket) before the first tournament match starts.
rules.mode_b_desc: Phases open round by round. You have 24-48h to predict the next one with the actual qualifiers.
rules.note_desc: The "Hall of Fame" (Champion, Golden Boot, etc.) is always completed before the tournament starts.
rules.bot_intro: Our World Agent will keep you updated on everything:
rules.bot_li1: Alerts when a new round opens (Mode B).
rules.scoring_intro: Points are calculated cumulatively for each match:
rules.score_diff_sub: If you got the sign right
rules.scoring_example: Example: If you say 2-1 and it ends 2-1, you score 30 points (10 sign + 10 difference + 10 exact bonus).
rules.ko_intro: In K.O. rounds, there's a vital rule:
rules.tie_rule_1: If you predict a draw (e.g. 1-1) in knockout rounds, the system will ask you to pick who wins on penalties.
rules.tie_rule_2: Only the team you pick as penalty winner will advance to the next round in your bracket.
rules.restrict_1: Predictions cannot be changed once the match/tournament has started.
rules.restrict_2: You can change your scores as many times as you want before the deadline.
rules.restrict_3: In case of a tie in the overall standings, the player with the most exact results wins.
rules.footer: The final rules depend on the configuration set by your group administrator.
